Mrs. ___ was admitted to the hospital and taken to the

Operating Room where she underwent a left thoracotomy and 
completion pneumonectomy, mediastinal lymph node dissection and 
buttressing of bronchial staple line with thymic fat.

She 
tolerated the procedure well and returned to the SICU in stable 
condition.

Her pain was initially not relieved with IV Dilaudid 
and she subsequently had an epidural placed which had good 
effect.

Unfortunately it caused some low blood pressures and it 
was turned off and she used a PCA for pain relief which was 
adequate.

She was able to use an incentive spirometer somewhat 
effectively and her hemodynamics remained stable.

She has a history of PAF and developed atrial fibrillation on 
post op day #3 despite resuming her pre op medications of
Diltiazem and Metoprolol.

Her rates were occasionally as high 
as 130-140 BPM and she required neosynephrine for 
vasoconstriction as her blood pressure was ___ /50 with a 
rapid rate.

The Cardiology service was consulted and followed 
her on a daily basis.

She was placed on IV Diltiazem and short 
acting metoprolol and eventually required digoxin for adequate 
rate control.
In the interim she was anticoagulated with
Coumadin.

Although she occasionally would convert to NSR she 
was unable to sustain it.

Sotolol was started and she converted 
after one dose.
Her sinus rate was in the 60 range therefore
Diltiazem and Digoxin were stopped.
She was maintained on
Sotolol and Metoprolol and was able to maintain NRS.

Her blood 
pressure 110/50 and she was progressing well.

She developed a leukocytosis of 13K on ___ and was started 
on Vancomycin and Zosyn empirically for a right pneumonia.

She 
was not febrile nor did she have any sputum production.

She was 
pan cultured and her urine culture grew Pseudomonas aeruginosa 
and she was placed on a 5 day course of Cipro.

She remained 
afebrile without any other symptoms but her WBC continued to 
rise.

Her CXR was clear on the right side except for a small 
right pleural effusion.

She had an ultrasound of the right 
effusion but it was considered minimal.

Her room air 
saturations were 94%.

She felt that it was due to being off of her hydroxyurea which 
she takes for PCV therefore it was resumed.
Her oxygen saturations were 88% with activity after many

She remained in NRS for 48 hours prior to discharge and her INR 
was 2.9.
